name: Overlap Card
description: Stack of overlapping photo cards that fan out with small satellite cards on hover, with skip and like buttons that slide between image groups.
contents: Groups of four large and four small image cards with a label
Skip and like round buttons with dot indicators
behavior: Hovering a group fans the large cards out and spreads the small cards around with rotation and shadow
Skip and like buttons slide to the previous or next group with a scale transition and wrap around
Active dot stretches and uses the accent color
editableByProps: Number of groups, images and labels
Card size, accent color, background color
Button aria labels, visibility of buttons and label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change fanned-out positions of large cards
Change fanned-out positions of small cards

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Each group holds exactly four large and four small cards
Sizes use vmin units so the stack scales with the viewport
Fan-out is triggered by mouse hover
